correctness.rationale: The binary length-eight two-deletion incidence matrix has 256 distinct codeword columns and 64 possible length-six outputs. For list allowance two, exact two-parent incidence constraints formulate integer packing. An inspected standalone checker specifies an exhaustive 199-node/100-leaf branching tree with strict rational dual upper bounds at every feasible leaf; the original certificate JSON Git blob is present and readable through GitHub, but its full per-leaf data were not independently replayed in the container. Instead an independently generated MILP reconstructed all 16,384 incidences and obtained optimum 15 with zero solver gap; this is corroboration, not replacement for original exact certificate. The explicit 15-word n=8 and 16-word n=9 codes were independently checked for all two-deletion descendants, and a common-prefix injection proves that n<8 cannot carry 16 messages. Correctness best-of-knowledge is supported by the clear exact branch dual proof and known prior independent complete rational certificate of M8=15.
